_about: 2-Propanol (1) + Water (2): isobaric T-x-y at 100.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 2-propanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 2-propanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Orchilles, A. V., Miguel, P. J.[Pablo J.], Gonzalez-Alfaro, V.[Vicenta], Llopis, F. J.[Francisco J.], Vercher, E.[Ernesto], Martinez-Andreu, A.[Antoni], Isobaric vapor-liquid equilibria for the extractive distillation of 2-propanol + water mixtures using 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium dicyanamide ionic liquid, J. Chem. Thermodyn. 110 (2017) 16-24
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0078. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.08 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
